title: Adorable Mochi Pets
description: Adopt, name, breed and carry adorable Mochi companions. 24 pastel colour morphs, cheek pouches, cozy beds, armor & trims, crops, ore & danger sense, shoulder perching and treats. Original tameable GeckoLib pets.
body:
# Adorable Mochi Pets 🐹

**Adopt, name, and raise your own tiny Mochi — a chubby, cube-cheeked companion that follows you, guards you, sleeps in its cozy bed, and begs for treats with a happy little *boing boing*.**

Original, hand-crafted Fabric mod for **Minecraft 26.1.2 and 26.2**. Tameable [GeckoLib](https://modrinth.com/mod/geckolib)-animated pets with a whole lot of personality.

---

## ✨ Meet your Mochi

- **24 pastel colour morphs** — from *classic pink* and *snow* to *midnight*, *matcha sage*, *bubblegum*, *mocha* and more. Every Mochi is a little different.
- **Random sizes & personalities** — lazy, playful, shy, brave, or greedy. Each personality changes how your Mochi idles and reacts.
- **Expressive GeckoLib animations** — big shiny eyes that track *you*, ear flops, cheek jiggles, stretches, munching, and combat moves.
- **Breeding with inherited colours** — pair two Mochi and raise adorable babies.

## 🍽️ Care & feeding

- **Cheek pouches!** Feed your Mochi and watch its cheeks puff up as it stows snacks — then nibble them later with a shower of food crumbs.
- Home-grown foods: **cucumbers, green beans, cheese, acorns**, plus treats like **sweet dango**, **mochi treats** and **bamboo treats**.
- Cook & combine: **sliced cucumber**, **steamed green beans**, **food mix**.

## 🛏️ Beds & home

- **Cozy Mochi beds in 11 wood types** — a soft cushion in a little wooden basket.
- **Right-click a bed** to assign your nearest Mochi to it — it'll trot over, curl up, and sleep. That bed becomes its home; it wanders nearby and always finds its way back.

## 🌱 Farming & décor

- **Cucumber & green bean crops** with seeds, plus **wild bushes** to forage in the world.
- **Glowing sunflower** decoration.
- **Storage crates** (acorn, cucumber, green beans, food mix) — compress 9 of an item into a tidy block, and unpack it any time.

## ⚔️ Loyal & useful

- **Guards its owner** — remembers who hurt you and fights back, with lunges, spins and bites.
- **Wearable armor in 5 tiers** (acorn → netherite) with **smithing trim** support — visible on the model.
- **Danger & ore sense** — your Mochi warns you about threats and perks up near valuable ores.
- **Shoulder perching** — carry your Mochi on your shoulder like a parrot.
- **Levels up** the more you adventure together.

## 🎁 Extras

- Built-in illustrated **Mochi Guide Book** (given on first join).
- Advancements, custom sounds, and a spawn egg.
- Full **English & Turkish** translations.
- Optional integration with **[Mod Menu](https://modrinth.com/mod/modmenu)** (in-game settings) and **[Jade](https://modrinth.com/mod/jade)** (hover info).

---

## 📦 Requirements

| | |
|---|---|
| **Minecraft** | 26.1.2 or 26.2 (pick the matching file) |
| **Mod loader** | Fabric |
| **Required** | Fabric API · GeckoLib 5.5+ |
| **Optional** | Mod Menu · Jade |

## 💬 Bug reports & feedback

Found a bug, or something feels off? Reach me on Discord: **emreconf**

The source is closed, so there is no public issue tracker — Discord is the fastest way to get a fix in.

---

*Original mod — models, textures, animations and code are all made from scratch. Inspired by the charm of creature-companion mods, built entirely from the ground up. Made with 🩷 by conftag (Emre).*
